C74-LOM-COMPRESSORDEVICE.text: This class represents a Compressor device in Live. A CompressorDevice shares all of the children, functions and properties of a Device; listed below are the members unique to it.

The list of available source channels for the compressor's input routing in the sidechain. It's represented as a dictionary with the following key: available_input_routing_channels [list] The list contains dictionaries as described in input_routing_channel.

The list of available source types for the compressor's input routing in the sidechain. It's represented as a dictionary with the following key: available_input_routing_types [list] The list contains dictionaries as described in input_routing_type.

The currently selected source channel for the compressor's input routing in the sidechain. It's represented as a dictionary with the following keys: display_name [symbol] identifier [symbol] Can be set to all values found in the compressor's available_input_routing_channels.

The currently selected source type for the compressor's input routing in the sidechain. It's represented as a dictionary with the following keys: display_name [symbol] identifier [symbol] Can be set to all values found in the track's available_input_routing_types.

C74-LOM-DRIFTDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of a Drift device in Live. A DriftDevice has all the properties, functions and children of a Device.
The index of the available sources for modulating the Filter Frequency for the first modulation slot.
The list of the available sources for modulating the Filter Frequency for the first modulation slot.
The index of the available sources for modulating the Filter Frequency for the second modulation slot.
The list of the available sources for modulating the Filter Frequency for the second modulation slot.
The index of the available sources for modulating the LFO Amount.
The list of the available sources for modulating the LFO Amount.
The index of the available sources for modulating the Pitch for the first modulation slot.
The list of the available sources for modulating the Pitch for the first modulation slot.
The index of the available sources for modulating the Pitch for the second modulation slot.
The list of the available sources for modulating the Pitch for the second modulation slot.
The index of the available sources for modulating Shape.
The list of the available sources for modulating Shape.
The index of the available sources for the first custom modulation slot.
The list of the available sources for the first custom modulation slot.
The index of the available sources for the second custom modulation slot.
The list of the available sources for the second custom modulation slot.
The index of the available sources for the third custom modulation slot.
The list of the available sources for the third custom modulation slot.
The index of the available targets for the first custom modulation slot.
The list of the available targets for the first custom modulation slot.
The index of the available targets for the second custom modulation slot.
The list of the available targets for the second custom modulation slot.
The index of the available targets for the third custom modulation slot.
The list of the available targets for the third custom modulation slot.
The amount for the MIDI Pitch Bend range in semitones.
The index of the voice count parameter.
The list of available voice count settings.
The index of the voice mode utilized by Drift.
The list of available voice modes.

C74-LOM-DRUMCELLDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of a Drum Sampler device in Live. A DrumCell has all the properties, functions and children of a Device. Listed below are members unique to DrumCell Device.
The sample gain, as normalized value.

C74-LOM-EQ8DEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of an EQ Eight device in Live. An Eq8Device has all the properties, functions and children of a Device. Listed below are members unique to Eq8Device.

Access to EQ Eight's edit mode, which toggles the channel currently available for editing. The available edit modes depend on the global mode (see global_mode) and are encoded as follows: In L/R mode: 0 = L, 1 = R In M/S mode: 0 = M, 1 = S In Stereo mode: 0 = A, 1 = B (inactive)
Access to EQ Eight's global mode. The modes are encoded as follows: 0 = Stereo 1 = L/R 2 = M/S
Access to EQ Eight's Oversampling parameter. 0 = Off, 1 = On.

C74-LOM-EQ8DEVICE_VIEW.text: Represents the view aspects of an Eq8Device. An Eq8Device.View has all the children, properties and functions of a Device.View. Listed below are members unique to it.
The index of the currently selected filter band.

C74-LOM-HYBRIDREVERBDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of a Hybrid Reverb device in Live. A HybridReverbDevice has all the properties, functions and children of a Device. Listed below are members unique to HybridReverbDevice.
The attack time of the amplitude envelope for the impulse response, in seconds.
The index of the selected impulse response category.
The list of impulse response categories.
The decay time of the amplitude envelope for the impulse response, in seconds.
The index of the selected impulse response files from the current category.
The list of impulse response files from the selected category.
The relative size of the impulse response, 0.0 to 1.0.
Enables transforming the current selected impulse response with an amplitude envelope and size parameter. 1 = enabled.

C74-LOM-LOOPERDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of a Looper device in Live. An LooperDevice has all the properties, functions and children of a Device. Listed below are members unique to LooperDevice.
1 = Looper will switch to overdub after recording, when recording a fixed number of bars. 0 = switch to playback without overdubbing.
Access to the Record Length chooser entry index.
Access to the list of Record Length chooser entry strings.
Double the speed of Looper's playback.
Halve the speed of Looper's playback.
Double the length of Looper's buffer.
Halve the length of Looper's buffer.
Play back while adding additional layers of incoming audio.
Erase everything that was recorded since the last time Overdub was enabled. Calling a second time will restore the material erased by the previous undo operation.

Parameter: clip_slot [ClipSlot] The target clip slot. Given a valid LOM ID of an empty clip slot on a non-frozen audio track, will export Looper's content to a clip in that slot. This is similar to using the Drag Me! control on the Looper device, and the same restrictions apply: the audio engine must be turned on, the Looper must actually hold audio content, the content must have a fixed length (i.e. Looper must not be recording), etc.

C74-LOM-MAXDEVICE.text: This class represents a Max for Live device in Live. A MaxDevice is a type of Device, meaning that it has all the children, properties and functions that a Device has. Listed below are the members unique to MaxDevice.
List of the audio inputs that the MaxDevice offers.
List of the audio outputs that the MaxDevice offers.
List of the midi inputs that the MaxDevice offers. Available since Live 11.0.
List of the midi outputs that the MaxDevice offers. Available since Live 11.0.
Returns: [int] the number of parameter banks.
Parameters: bank_index [int] Returns: [list of symbols] The name of the parameter bank specified by bank_index.

Parameters: bank_index [int] Returns: [list of ints] The indices of the parameters contained in the bank specified by bank_index. Empty slots are marked as -1. Bank index -1 refers to the "Best of" bank.

C74-LOM-MELDDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of a Meld device in Live. A MeldDevice has all the properties, functions and children of a Device.
Meld's oscillator engine selector. The modes are encoded as follows: 0 = Engine A 1 = Engine B
Selects the Unison voice count. The modes are encoded as follows: 0 = off 1 = two 2 = three 3 = four
Selects the polyphony mode. The modes are encoded as follows: 0 = mono 1 = poly
Selects the polyphony voice count. The modes are encoded as follows: 0 = two 1 = three 2 = four 3 = five 4 = six 5 = eight 6 = twelve

C74-LOM-PLUGINDEVICE.text: This class represents a plug-in device. A PluginDevice is a type of Device, meaning that it has all the children, properties and functions that a Device has. Listed below are the members unique to PluginDevice.
The opened state of the plug-in's editor window.
Get the list of the plug-in's presets.
Get/set the index of the currently selected preset.

C74-LOM-ROARDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of a Roar device in Live. A RoarDevice has all the properties, functions and children of a Roar Device.
The index of the routing mode utilized by Roar.
The list of available routing modes.
Get, set and observe the Envelope Input Listen toogle.

C74-LOM-SHIFTERDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of the Shifter audio effect. A ShifterDevice is a type of device, meaning that it has all the children, properties and functions that a device has. Listed below are members unique to ShifterDevice.
The pitch bend range used in MIDI Pitch Mode.
The current pitch mode index: 0 = Internal, 1 = MIDI

C74-LOM-SPECTRALRESONATORDEVICE.text: This class represents an instance of a Spectral Resonator device in Live. An SpectralResonatorDevice has all the properties, functions and children of a Device. Listed below are members unique to SpectralResonatorDevice.
Get, set and observe the Freq control's mode. 0 = Hertz, 1 = MIDI note values.
Get, set and observe the MIDI gate switch's state. 0 = Off, 1 = On.
Get, set and observe the Modulation Mode. 0 = None, 1 = Chorus, 2 = Wander, 3 = Granular.
Get, set and observe the Mono/Poly switch's state. 0 = Mono, 1 = Poly.
Get, set and observe the Pitch Mode. 0 = Internal, 1 = MIDI.
Get, set and observe the Pitch Bend Range.\
Get, set and observe the Polyphony. 0 = 2, 1 = 4, 2 = 8, 3 = 16 voices.

C74-LOM-WAVETABLEDEVICE.text: This class represents a Wavetable instrument. A WavetableDevice shares all of the children, functions and properties that a Device has. Listed below are members unique to it.
Access to the current filter routing. 0 = Serial, 1 = Parallel, 2 = Split.
Access to Wavetable's Poly/Mono switch. 0 = Mono, 1 = Poly.
Access to oscillator 1's effect mode. 0 = None, 1 = Fm, 2 = Classic, 3 = Modern.
Access to oscillator 1's wavetable category selector.
Access to oscillator 2's wavetable category selector.
Access to oscillator 1's wavetable index selector.
Access to oscillator 2's wavetable index selector.
List of names of the wavetables currently available for oscillator 1. Depends on the current wavetable category selection (see oscillator_1_wavetable_category).
List of names of the wavetables currently available for oscillator 2. Depends on the current wavetable category selection (see oscillator_2_wavetable_category).
List of the names of the available wavetable categories.
The current number of polyphonic voices.
Access to Wavetable's unison mode parameter. 0 = None 1 = Classic 2 = Shimmer 3 = Noise 4 = Phase Sync 5 = Position Spread 6 = Random Note
Access to the number of unison voices.
List of the names of modulation targets currently visible in the modulation matrix.
Parameter: parameter_to_add [DeviceParameter] Add an instrument parameter to the modulation matrix. Only works for parameters that can be modulated (see is_parameter_modulatable).
Parameter: index [int] Return the modulation target parameter name at index in the modulation matrix as a [symbol].

Parameters: modulation_target_index [int] modulation_source_index [int] Return the amount of the modulation of the parameter at modulation_target_index by the modulation source at modulation_source_index in Wavetable's modulation matrix.
Parameter: parameter [DeviceParameter] 1 = parameter can be modulated. Call this before add_parameter_to_modulation_matrix.

Parameters: modulation_target_index [int] modulation_source_index [int] Set the amount of the modulation of the parameter at modulation_target_index by the modulation source at modulation_source_index in Wavetable's modulation matrix.
